paper_item: Central mechanism claim: the text pathway drives MIFlu
paper_claim_or_content: MIFlu improves forecasting by incorporating prior knowledge via the textual input embedder and LoRA fine-tuning (text near Fig. 3)
our_value_or_reason: Our two replays disagree. The A0 GPU verbatim replay shows the text pathway ACTIVE (non-zero text embedder gradient). The Stage2 CPU replay measures EXACTLY ZERO effect from the text pathway. The contradiction is unresolved.
consequence_for_our_claims: This is our single most important open item. We must publish it as an open contradiction, not resolve it in the paper's favour.

paper_item: Claim: MIFlu beats all comparatives except MSE at L=24
paper_claim_or_content: MIFlu outperforms the other models in all cases except for the MSE at L = 24 (text near Fig. 3)
our_value_or_reason: Not testable under our protocol. On the July-2026 (B-track) 4L x 10-seed run, gpt2_miflu ranks 1 by MSE (0.770872) but timecma/qwen/calf all lose to nlinear/patchtst/dlinear/itransformer on average.
consequence_for_our_claims: We neither confirm nor refute it. Our B-track ordering is protocol-different and seed-count-different.
